body: Switching a kinematic traffic car to dynamic on CollisionStart is one step late: probe Q4 (avian3d 0.7.0) shows a dynamic box at 10 m/s stopping dead against a resting kinematic box (infinite mass) while the switch one tick before contact gives both ~2.1 m/s. CollisionStart alone rejected as the switch trigger; kept only as a backstop.

K->D switch = predictive proximity test in FixedPostUpdate before PhysicsSystems::First (inflated chassis box, dynamic awake body, closing speed >= threshold) + insert(RigidBody::Dynamic) via commands; probe Q3 shows the insert takes effect in the same step. Alternative rejected: CollisionStart-only (wall effect).

AI drivers of traffic and police cars are not character entities while seated (TrafficCar/PoliceCar data); a civilian or cops are spawned only on hijack/dismount. Alternative rejected: seated Driving character entities per AI car (touches civilian cap counting, civilian/police FSMs, perception, 24+ extra Tnua bodies).

Police cars are dynamic from spawn and driven by a shared pure-pursuit autopilot (vehicle/autopilot.rs writing the car's own DriveIntent); traffic uses the same autopilot after the K->D switch. Alternative rejected: kinematic police cars (the chase would end at the first contact).

Crew aboard police cars counts toward the row's units; dismounted cops re-board their parked car when the player drives away. Alternatives rejected: crew outside the unit cap (22 cops at 5 stars vs GDD cap 12) and no re-boarding (no car chase after the first dismount while the foot cops hold the cap).
Traffic lane slot (inner lane) derived in gta_sim from the lane's lateral offset to its road edge; citygen untouched (no golden hash risk). Alternative: a slot field on citygen::Lane.

Kinematic->dynamic switch uses a swept time-to-contact test (horizon 0.1 s, skin 0.1 m) instead of PLAN's flat 1.0 m inflation + closing>=0.5 m/s; alternative kept only as broadphase. Reason: a pedestrian crossing 1.2 m in front of a waiting bumper closes at ~0.52 m/s and would switch cars that never return to kinematic.

Cars in the fire line block only the segment shooter->target with plain clearance (analytic rectangle test), not PLAN's perimeter samples through FireLine::blocked (reach past the target + spread cone). Reason: parked cars/traffic behind or beside the player would starve cops/gunmen in streets.

Q-B crime path: bail-out writes DriverScared, record_crimes records Crime::Shooting for that attack; alternative (rely on the muzzle<=15 m person rule) rejected because the driver is data and a ranged cabin shot would leave the flee-then-call with nothing to report.

Foot dispatcher reserves (row.cars - active cars) x car.crew units while a TrafficGraph exists; rejected PLAN/V2 unreserved race (1 car + 1 foot spawn per tick fills row 5 as 4 cars + 4 foot, 5th car never spawns, rows 4-5 liveness and bench wait fail).

Pull-out uses only a clear LEFT-door spot (non-forced clear_spots); rejected PLAN's exit_spot(forced): a right-door/roof exit puts the player >3 m from the cop and arrest_step returns BrokeFree (+1 star).

TTC switch keeps sleeping dynamic bodies (v_other = 0); rejected the 'not Sleeping' filter: a kinematic car driving into a sleeping parked/abandoned car would never switch predictively (infinite-mass shove until the backstop).
PR1 fixture liveness 'no car moved in the first 64 ticks -> GATE BROKEN' rejected: contact/hijack fixtures hold cars stopped by design; liveness is TrafficStats.casts growth instead.

Bail-out call determinism by the named mutation CivilianConfig.call_after_flee = 1.0 (tests/wanted.rs precedent); rejected PR1's 'calm temperament with report weight forced high' (call_later ignores temperament).

Intersection request distance = v^2/(2b) + 2*s0 + half_length instead of PLAN's v^2/(2b) + s0 + half_length: at rest IDM stops the bumper exactly s0 before the stop line, so PLAN's threshold equals the rest position and the head of a queue crept asymptotically to the line before asking (loop gate: cars ~1 m/s, 197 m in 100 s). Alternative rejected: a request flag set when speed reaches 0 (misses a car rolling slowly behind a queue).

AC1 loop in the z 22..38 band (PLAN geometry) jams: 10 m corner lanes cannot hold one car plus the 6.08 m don't-block-the-box room, every corner is a stop at a=0.73. Loop moved to the floor perimeter (x, z within 37 m, clear of all test-area blocks).

PLAN flip 'leader search limited to own segment -> overlap after a corner' stays GREEN on the loop, also with the connector virtual entries and the destination-room rule removed: without conflicts nothing stops right past a corner. Replaced by flip 'leaders ignored' (RED, overlap at tick 270).

Traffic spawn near a lane end starts at min(v0, sqrt(2b * distance to the IDM stop point)) instead of PLAN's 'skip points closer than v0^2/(2b)+s0+half_length to the lane end': with b = 1.67 that skip needs 80 m of avenue lane, longer than most core lanes, and the seed-1 bubble produced zero off-frame spawns (gate 24 liveness 27/0). Alternative rejected: using max_deceleration in the skip (cars would spawn at 16 m/s next to the player and brake at 8 m/s^2).

Police car A* goal = first lane passing within max(nearest lane distance, 0.75 x dismount_distance) of the target instead of the one nearest lane: the nearest lane often runs the wrong way (the player's side of the street), and the car looped the block forever passing 23 m away (crew_reboards never dismounted). Alternative rejected: allowing U-turn connectors (citygen has none).

Police car route_done = remaining path <= dismount_distance (PLAN: route end): a car held behind a parked police car or a queue near the goal would never reach the end. Police cars also cast only turn_sense_distance ahead on connectors, like traffic (a straight cast saw the cars waiting at the other stop lines and crawled at 3 m/s).

Crew re-boards at the nearer door (left or right) and police_fsm seeks that door; PLAN's left door made a cop dismounted on the right side walk into the car body and time out (open risk turned into a failing gate).

PLAN flip 'count only foot units in the car dispatcher -> row 2 overruns' stays GREEN: every shipped row has cars x crew <= units, so the car cap binds first. Seat-reservation flip is RED on rows 3-5.

PLAN gate 30b(a) 'no BulletHitVehicle on the corner car in 1920 ticks' is unreachable with PLAN R7 (cars block only the segment with plain clearance, no spread cone): the repositioned line clears the corner by 0.5 m and spread still lands pellets (police 8/252, gang 6/144 vs 24 and 17 with the rule off). Gate asserts the aggregate waste is at most half of the unruled count; flips RED.

Police response fix recommended = A* goal radius nearest + car.goal_margin (data, 10 m) plus car.blocked_seconds 2.0; rejected car.spawn_ring (30,60) alone (park still 49.9 s) and 'foot fills reserved seats' (changes the GDD per-row car count, owner call). Probe: park 63.1 s shipped, 11.8 s with blocked 2; route median 376 m -> 91 m with nearest+10.

Gridlock: required in-slice fix is junction room() seeing non-AI vehicles and police cars never stopping on a connector; lane pass-around (opposite inner lane) deferred to an orchestrator/owner scope decision because GDD 5.2 has no lane change.

Junction: a waiter denied only for room past the box no longer blocks later conflicting connectors; kept FCFS blocking for conflict-denied waiters. Rejected: every queued connector blocks (one car stuck behind an abandoned car locked every movement crossing it: 2 crossings in 100 s vs 6..12).

Room past the box = AI occupancy AND a chassis-high box query on the Vehicle layer over the needed stretch, excluding this tick's AI cars. Rejected: projecting non-AI cars into the occupancy (police/taken/abandoned cars have no lane cursor; rotated wrecks would need footprint projection).

Police A* goal on the car's own start lane counts only the stretch ahead of the car. Rejected: the whole lane (with radius nearest+10 a car spawned past the goal point 'arrived' at once and dismounted 44.7 m out: car_closes_in_and_dismounts RED).

Minimal go-around (overtake via the oncoming inner lane) stopped per orchestrator STOP rule: needs an opposite-lane graph relation, per-car overtake state and an oncoming-stretch reservation honoured by oncoming IDM, junction room and the spawner; kinematic overtakers are invisible to oncoming kinematic cars (forward casts skip kinematic traffic), so any missed consumer = cars passing through each other.

Police car with no lane route: speed 0 where it is and the crew dismounts (no_route sense); an in-intersection car keeps >= turn_speed and never dismounts there (TrafficGraph::in_junction, connector bounds grown by half length). Rejected: reviewer's 'hold until a route exists' alone (the car would stand in the lane until blocked_seconds).

Police car spawn points only on lanes heading towards last_known (tangent . (target - point) > 0). Rejected: any lane in the (30, 60) ring (t15 chase failed 2/2: first = closest 31-33 m; BRP trace showed the near car facing away and looping a 4-lane block to 133 m; with the old ring t15 passed).

A driver farther than reboard_distance never triggers Respond -> Dismounted (driven_off sense). Rejected: dismount then re-board (a car at its route end flipped Respond/Dismounted every tick: 1132 transitions in 25 s in the headless chase probe, crew out and back in each tick).

When nobody can get out (no free door, roof excluded) the Respond -> Dismounted transition is undone and retried next tick. Rejected: stay Dismounted with the crew aboard (next_car_state sends it back to Respond at once: a per-tick flip-flop).

Police spawn 'clear lane ahead' check (25 m box) did not fix car_closes_in_and_dismounts: the car was held by a traffic car spawned in front of it after the police car (InitialFill). Check removed; the gate was re-anchored to follow the first car that gets out near the player.

Runtime cabin shot over BRP abandoned after 4 tries: a traffic car stopped by the player standing in its lane drives off as soon as the player steps aside to get a side-window line, and aim_at (0.3 s per correction) cannot track it; the Q-B bail-out stays covered by the headless traffic_bailout gate plus the owner checklist.

t15 hijack flake classified as a harness defect, not a game bug: in the failing attempt the player, teleported 12 m ahead of a moving car, was KnockedDown when F was sent (enter_exit consumes the request and ignores it while knocked down); the car had switched to Dynamic on the contact. Alternative rejected: treating the ignored F as an entry bug (entering while knocked down is refused by design since T14).

Bug 1: driven_off = driving && car.stopped < stopped_seconds && distance > reboard_distance, one PoliceCar::driven_off used at all five sites (sense, re-board timer, retry dismount, board_police_cars, cop door walk). Alternative rejected: QA's change at the sense only; the re-board sites kept distance-only and would pull a crew that got out for a stopped driver straight back in (slower flip-flop).

Bug 2: pull_out excludes every cop in Arrest from the exit-spot blockers, plus arrest.pull_give_up_seconds (3.0): after it the driver is pulled out at any clear exit and ArrestAttempt resets (foot arrest starts over, no break-free). Alternative rejected: making the second cop step clear of the door spot (needs a new motion rule in police_fsm and still leaves walls/bodies blocking forever).

Bug 4: forward cast starts at the nose (bodies at the flank ignored) and dynamic traffic target speed v + a/(acceleration*speed_gain) while a > 0 (was v + a*dt: 0.3 m in 5 s from rest). Alternative rejected: creeping into the pedestrian at walking speed (pushes civilians with a dynamic car) and pedestrian-side avoidance of cars (civilians have no avoidance at all; unbounded).

vehicle_seat::no_arrest_in_a_car (red at b944403, local 4/4 and CI) classified as a stale TASK-015 gate, not a game bug: at 1 star with a stopped car and a cop in Arrest at the door, O2 now pulls the driver out; the gate passed before only because the cop's own body blocked the left-door spot (flip pullers -> &[] makes it green again). Alternative rejected: treating the pull-out as a regression.

Temporary runtime flip: police car IDM target v + a/(acceleration*speed_gain) (the traffic fix of bug 4b) in car_route.rs; t15 chase passed 2/4 instead of 0/3 on the failing geometry. The crawl is one cause; the other is that the cars route to a stale last_known (the player drove off unseen past a traffic queue) and dismount there. Restored, sha256 OK.

O2 city pull-out: cops near a driver's door (arrest.approach_distance 20 m) enter Arrest without sight and walk to the door around car rectangles (tactics::around_cars); the arresting cop faces the door. Rejected the verbatim 'Arrest cop seeks the door without LOS': the stalled cops were in Respond (sees=false), never Arrest, and already seeking directly; a car body, invisible to the walls-only avoidance, stopped them.

Stop-and-go hysteresis: driven_off = driving && moving >= car.moving_seconds (2.0) && distance > reboard_distance; a crew gets out for a driver (any reason) only once his car stood stopped_seconds. Alternative (raise stopped_seconds only) rejected: re-boards were the other half of the loop.

STOP rule (orchestrator): t15 chase fails 3/5 (runs 2,4,5: nearest police car never closer than the first sample, ~31 m). Police cars spawn in the traffic queue behind the player on his lane, follow traffic at <= 8 m/s after the IDM fix (no crawl), lose sight behind the queue, drive to a stale last_known and dismount ~100 m away. Needs passing traffic (go-around, STOPPED in round 1) or a different car model; not patched further.

Option B spawn filter (no AI traffic ahead on the police car's lane route to the player) applies only while the player drives a car faster than exit_max_speed. Alternative rejected: the literal filter on every dispatch turned 8 sim gates red (O2 stopped-driver busted seeds 1-3, stop-and-go seed 3, cars_follow_row 2-5, dead crew slot): a stopped driver sits in a queue so every approach to him is behind traffic, and at the hospital 6 of 7 ring points are queued.

t15 police pressure 1/5 with the pursuit-scoped filter (runs 1,3,4,5 fail identically): both police cars are already out at 30-31 m at the first chase sample, spawned during the 2-star raise while the hijacked car still stood (filter off by the moving test) behind the traffic that queued behind it; the player drives off, the cars recede to ~100 m, crews get out ~90 m back. Not patched further per the orchestrator note.
